name: game-dev-floor
description: /devfloor: an animated pixel-art dev office in a pane. The main loop types at the LEAD desk, each subagent walks in to a desk; screens show the tool kind, a failed call flashes red, a guard's refusal sets off the beacon, the window's sky is context left, coffee cups are cost and the server rack's lights are plan usage left

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: off draws nothing; casual draws the floor; hardcore adds each worker's run time to the caption

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: The colors of the name row and the caption; nes, gameboy and amber are made for dark terminals, theme follows your Claude Code theme

autoOpen.title: Open on the first prompt
autoOpen.description: Open the pane by itself when the session's first turn starts (on terminals 144 columns wide or more)

fps.title: Frames per second
fps.description: How often the floor repaints while something moves, 4 to 30; a still floor is not repainted
